name: 18-methoxycoronaridine
summary: 18-Methoxycoronaridine (18-MC; developmental code name MM-110), also known as zolunicant (INNTooltip International Nonproprietary Name), is a derivative of ibogaine invented in 1996 by the research team around the pharmacologist Stanley D. Glick from the Albany Medical College and the chemists Upul K. Bandarage and Martin E. Kuehne from the University of Vermont.

pharmacology.text: 18-MC is a α3β4 nicotinic antagonist and, in contrast to ibogaine, has no affinity at the α4β2 subtype nor at NMDA-channels nor at the serotonin transporter, and has significantly reduced affinity for sodium channels and for the σ receptor, but retains modest affinity for μ-opioid receptors where it acts as an agonist, and κ-opioid receptors.

uses.text: 18-MC was originally developed by Savant HWP and later acquired by MindMed in 2019 for development as a treatment for opioid use disorder. Due to strategic reprioritization, MindMed discontinued active development of MM-110 in 2023 and has been seeking non-dilutive funding or partners to potentially restart the program; as of 2025 the program remains shelved.

summaryZh: 18-甲氧基冠狗牙花定鹼，或叫佐魯尼坎，是一種有機化合物，分子式C22H28N2O3，屬於伊波加因的衍生物，1996年被開發為藥物。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about its effects in people, as it has only been through early clinical testing.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少，因為它只經過早期臨床試驗。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少，因为它只经过早期临床试验。

fact.en: It was designed in 1996 as a cleaner version of ibogaine, the alkaloid from the African shrub Tabernanthe iboga, aiming to keep its anti-addiction promise without the hallucinations and heart risks.
fact.zh: 它在1996年被設計為伊博格鹼的改良版本，伊博格鹼來自非洲灌木Tabernanthe iboga，目標是保留其抗成癮潛力，同時去除幻覺與心臟風險。
fact.zhHans: 它在1996年被设计为伊博格碱的改良版本，伊博格碱来自非洲灌木Tabernanthe iboga，目标是保留其抗成瘾潜力，同时去除幻觉与心脏风险。
